Definition: of a strong color, i.e. red (others fleet)
BiblicalUsage: The word appears only twice, both times in Zechariah's vision of the four chariots: the fourth chariot has grisled and bay horses, and the bay go forth to walk to and fro through the earth. The colour is a strong red-brown — the same word can mean red — and the horses are part of the patrol God sends out over the whole earth.
TheologicalSignificance: Two verses about the colour of horses carry no teaching of their own; their weight is Zechariah's vision, that God's watchers walk the whole earth and report back to Him.
